title: Glowy Super™ Gel & CitySet™ Gift Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, oilFree, alcoholFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Fragrance Free✓ Non-Comedogenic
What it is: A duo that features a full size of Glowy Super™ Gel, in bestselling Warmglow shade, and of CitySet™ Lightweight Setting Spray.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Start with Glowy Super™ Gel illuminator as your forever first step under makeup for hydrated, glowy radiance. Set your entire look for up to 16 hours by spritzing on CitySet™ Lightweight Setting Spray. Both essentials are noncomedogenic, fragrance-free, safe for sensitive skin, and dermatologist-tested.

This Set Contains:
- 1 oz/ 30 mL Glowy Super™ Gel in Warmglow (soft warm gold)
- 3.2 oz/ 94 mL CitySet™ Lightweight Setting Spray

Clean + P
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply one to two pumps of Glowy Super™ Gel all over under your favorite foundation, tinted moisturizer, or other complexion products.
-Use fingertips or The Big Brush (sold separately) to blend in.
-With closed eyes, hold the bottle five to eight inches away from the face and mist evenly over the entire face.
Ingredients+
Glowy Super Gel:
Aqua/Water/Eau, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, Glycerin, Mica, Squalane, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Polysorbate 60, Sorbitan Isostearate, Phenethyl Alcohol, Caprylyl Glycol, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Tocopherol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Lactic Acid. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491)].

CitySet Lightweight Setting Spray:
Aqua/Water/Eau, Propanediol, Hydrolyzed Corn Starch, Pentylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Betaine, Glycerin, Citric Acid, Citrus Reticulata (Tangerine) Peel Extract, Glycogen, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Sodium Hydroxide.
The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
